title: Fail over user intent safely when a cloud attempt fails
goal: Connect selection and health updates to actual mission execution: after a classified failure choose another eligible credential/model or consented local target within a bounded attempt/deadline/spend budget. Preserve messages, capability requirements and tool state. Handle failures before response, during streaming and after ambiguous completion; do not duplicate external tool side effects or silently splice incompatible partial answers. Explicit pins and policy constraints remain binding. Hermetic injected-provider tests prove usable fallback succeeds, shared-account failures stay scoped and exhaustion returns a typed actionable error. Implement tests named cloud_intent_failover_*; acceptance must execute at least one test. Selection is not completion: continue through permitted working alternatives until the actual user intent succeeds or eligible candidates/attempt, deadline or spending limits are exhausted. Never return success merely because a model was selected or a health probe passed. A highly ranked but failing model must not strand an intent while a compatible working alternative remains.
